verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes detailed API reference pages (createcart, getcart, REST API overview) and a sandbox environment for testing agentic-commerce flows without touching production, which supports an exploratory developer experience. However, there's no direct evidence of an interactive 'try it now' console or embedded runnable code examples on the API reference pages themselves (e.g., Swagger-style live execution), only static documentation plus a separate sandbox environment. missing for 10: evidence of in-page interactive/runnable code snippets or a live API explorer widget, independent corroboration of the reference's interactivity.
